description: This file implements a system notification handling component for an Android application, including classes and methods for permission checks, notification channel setup, and posting notifications with various parameters.

classes.name: SystemNotifyRequest
classes.description: Data class representing a notification request with title, body, sound, and priority.

classes.name: SystemNotificationPoster
classes.description: Interface defining methods for checking authorization and posting notifications.

classes.name: AndroidSystemNotificationPoster
classes.description: Implementation of SystemNotificationPoster for Android platform, managing permissions, channels, and notification posting.

classes.name: SystemHandler
classes.description: Main class that handles incoming notification requests, performs validation, authorization, and delegates to the poster.

methods.name: isAuthorized
methods.description: Checks if the application has permissions and notifications enabled to post notifications.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Creates and posts a system notification based on the provided request.

methods.name: ensureChannel
methods.description: Ensures a notification channel exists for the given priority and returns its ID.

methods.name: compatPriority
methods.description: Converts string priority levels to NotificationCompat priority constants.

methods.name: isSilentSound
methods.description: Determines if the provided sound setting indicates a silent notification.

methods.name: handleSystemNotify
methods.description: Main method to process a notification request in JSON form, validate, authorize, and post notification.

methods.name: parseNotifyRequest
methods.description: Parses JSON parameters into a SystemNotifyRequest object.

methods.name: parseParamsObject
methods.description: Parses JSON string into JsonObject, handling errors gracefully.
